headSource: migration/evidence/NS03/c-freeze/prefreeze-audit.json; current HEAD is the human-accepted NS02 baseline; no rebuild/device action in C.

priorApprovedBaseline.policy: Human-accepted and committed NS02 baseline at current HEAD; no staging/commit/push in NS03 C.

decisions.summary: Exact runtime vuex 4.1.0; npm-resolved vue peer (3.5.44); no direct vue dependency, legacy peer bypass or .npmrc change. Unchanged template vue -> nativescript-vue alias and tsconfig mapping.

Human accepted A1 install/lockfile as is after original BLOCKED: csstype addition and TypeScript dev:true -> devOptional:true metadata allowed, version/resolved/integrity unchanged; no other churn. A2 resumed from accepted result.

Human authorized new type-only types/vuex.d.ts re-exporting shipped Vuex declarations after A2 bundler-resolution export-map failure (TS7016/cascading TS2769/TS7006). No handwritten types, runtime shim or config edit. A3 added shim and corrected only NS03 store-test action payload commits; all A3 gates passed.

Fresh keyed Vuex stores, typed useConferenceStore, RN03-equivalent state/mutations, public-core-derived getter, copied arrays, immutable snapshots via replaceState, load/retry promise boundary and stale-generation protection; strict:false.
Native ListView over pure toScheduleRows header/session rows with h:/s: keys and itemTemplateSelector; shared order; no sticky headers or new plugin.
Real core/loader Vitest logic, 11 reference cases and seven controlled lifecycle cases. Component rendering/taps proven on historical Android device plus coordinator pixels, not Vitest.

A3 debug APK rebuilt in A3 only, installed -r in B with matching installed hash; four XML/PNG frames for launch, last group, favorites and all; XML-derived taps, no text input. Search/no-match/clear device-unverified.

Native SearchBar exact textChange and SegmentedBar exact source titles; parent focus then native clearFocus/dismissSoftInput. Human accepts uppercase Android textAllCaps styling matching Ionic Material; B-launch final PASS on XML/coordinator pixels. Poll overshoot accepted as disclosed. Fixed light palette, no keyboard in coordinator pixels.

session.executor: Hermes GPT-6.1 Sol high / openai-codex / translation-migration, human-chosen
session.coordinator: Claude Code; live supervision, direct pixel inspection and review dispatch
session.phase: C: final static gates, handoff and revision 1 freeze only
session.stop: Next: none; STOP — NS04 requires a separate human assignment

environment.spawn: spawnSync argument arrays, shell:false; pinned Node first on child PATH; delete NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath case-insensitively
environment.historicalJava: Temurin 21.0.7+6 (Phase A evidence, not rerun in C)
environment.additionsDisposition: No toolchain/global install or persistent environment change; npm ci reinstalls ignored dependencies; core tests rebuild ignored dist.

historicalCommands.envPolicy: Pinned Node first on PATH; NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath removed case-insensitively; shell:false

subcaseCounts.policy: Subcases are included in their parent cases, not added to the 24 top-level case count; test executions are not acceptance-case counts.

coordinatorDispositions.authority: human, repeated in Phase C assignment
coordinatorDispositions.summary: A1 BLOCKED at csstype and TypeScript dev-to-devOptional; D1 amended and run 1 install/lockfile accepted unchanged; A2 resumed.

coordinatorDispositions.authority: human, repeated in Phase C assignment
coordinatorDispositions.summary: A2 BLOCKED by Vuex export-map declaration resolution; type-only shim authorized; A3 shim and NS03 store-test payload correction passed all A gates.

Uppercase labels accepted as Android textAllCaps styling matching Ionic Material segment; exact source titles confirmed. Final B-launch PASS on XML plus coordinator pixels; original FAIL records unchanged.
20.981-s third dump overshoot accepted as disclosed, not failure; first valid XML at 14.836 s is byte-identical to assertion XML.

coordinatorDispositions.authority: Claude Code coordinator inspection, acknowledged by human
coordinatorDispositions.summary: All four frames PASS; no keyboard at launch, no personal content; coordinator report immutable.

Whole-state replaceState preserves earlier deep-frozen snapshots. v-if recreates ListView on return from empty favorites, starting All sessions at the top. Neither is a deviation; scroll retention is not required.

warnings: npm ci: 6 vulnerabilities (5 moderate, 1 high); no audit remediation.
Pending install-script approvals for @nativescript/core, @parcel/watcher and core-js-pure; no approval/config changes.
Deprecations: source-map-resolve and webpack-chain. A3 build records NativeScript DEP0190 and Java deprecated-API warnings.
Bounded logcat includes thread-suspension, CPU-variant, HWUI and ashmem deprecation warning/error lines; no detected fatal pattern, not exhaustive runtime proof.
limits: Search/no-match/clear device-unverified under D5; covered through store tests, not device input.
Rendering, taps, launch keyboard and scrolling proven by historical Android observations and coordinator pixels only, not Vitest.
Light theme only; no dark-theme observation.
Headers are not sticky; scroll position is not retained across the observed mode switches.
